root_idea.summary: The root centers on roughness or hardness, extending from rugged terrain to inner roughness experienced as grief and to the causing or expression of grief.
root_idea.development: The physical sense of roughness is presented as the root orientation, with emotional grief understood as a corresponding harshness or roughness of the spirit.

qac_form_accounting.reason: حَزَن and حُزْن are recorded as vocalic variants of the same grief noun and are presented under one public entry.

senses.definition: To grieve, be sorrowful, sad, or unhappy.
senses.usage_conditions: Intransitive use: the subject experiences grief. In prohibitions such as “do not grieve,” the construction concerns avoiding what produces grief rather than voluntarily generating an emotion.

senses.definition: To cause someone or something to grieve; to sadden.
senses.usage_conditions: Transitive use with a person, event, affair, or other cause as the subject and the one affected as the object. Classical usage records variation in the perfect and imperfect vowel patterns.
A noun for emotional distress arising from an unpleasant event, loss, or comparable cause; the Quran also uses it in the expression of having grief removed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Rugged, hard, or high ground, including rugged mountains.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to terrain; land that is merely good but hard is not necessarily designated by this term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of an animal, to have a rough, difficult pace or to be difficult to ride.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied specifically to the animal’s manner of movement or ease of riding.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Reciting or reading with a slender, plaintive voice.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A vocal style characterized as plaintive rather than a separate emotional state.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be in rugged terrain or to put someone on rugged, hard ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May describe a place becoming rough for people or causing them to occupy such ground.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To treat people roughly or harshly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of using roughness with people.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To express pain, grief, or sorrow; to lament or moan for or on account of someone or something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An expressive or outward manifestation of grief.
A figurative pluralized extension from rugged or difficult terrain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A camel that pastures in rugged terrain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A lexical adjective associated with grazing in a tract designated حَزْنٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Affected by vehement or intense grief.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensified description of a person experiencing grief.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a sheep or goat, evil in disposition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to an animal’s bad or difficult temperament.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Grieving, mourning, lamenting, sorrowful, sad, or unhappy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival description of a person or other subject affected by grief.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A soft, gentle, slender, plaintive, and melodious voice.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional description of vocal quality.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The name of a certain bird.
One’s family or household, especially viewed as those for whose welfare one suffers grief or anxiety.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may also simply mean one’s family or household without requiring an explicit statement of anxiety.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A customary prior right of Arabs over foreigners concerning houses and lands, or the obligation to lodge and provision passing Arab soldiery.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A historical social and administrative usage associated with Arab settlements and military passage in Khurasan.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Causing grief or making someone mourn or be sorrowful.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to an event, affair, or case, and also to a voice in the recorded usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Grieved, sorrowful, or made to mourn or be sad.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The supplied lexical description records both an affected state and a causative gloss under this headword.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having roughness or a hanging slackness in the lower-jaw area, associated with grief.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical expression describing the angle or flesh of the lower jaw.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Intransitive experience of grief, with Quranic usage.
Being in or putting someone on rugged ground.
Rugged terrain and figurative harsh treatment.
Grief, sorrow, and Quran-attested removal of grief.
Bad disposition of a sheep or goat.
Pointer to an entry in another root.
Grieved or sorrowful, with a reported causative gloss.
Anatomical expression involving the lower jaw.

cautions: The Form I Quranic group is represented under حَزِنَ, while the lexical evidence records dialectal variation in the perfect and imperfect vowel patterns, especially for the transitive causative use.
حَزَن and حُزْن are retained as Quranic evidence but merged into one public noun entry because the supplied lexical discussion treats them as vocalic variants of grief.
The supplied description of مَحْزُونٌ combines a passive state with a causative gloss; both are retained cautiously rather than forcing a resolution not established by the packet.
